notes: The best value in this slice for MoE workloads and the only sub-$2,500 ticket to 128GB. One 256-bit LPDDR5X-8000 bus, ~256 GB/s theoretical / ~200-270 effective; unified memory lets you dedicate ~110-120 GB to the iGPU via GTT. Measured (lhl/strix-halo-testing): gpt-oss-120b MXFP4 33.7 t/s, GLM-4.5-Air 23.4, Qwen3-235B-A22B 15.1, dense Llama-3.3-70B Q4_K_M only ~5.0 - buy for MoE, NOT dense 70B. Measured 12.5 W idle, ~136-155 W load, essentially silent (Geerling sbc-reviews#80). Sibling boxes: GMKtec EVO-X2 128GB $2,199 (cheapest complete), EVO-X3 $3,799 (OCuLink), Beelink GTR9 Pro ~$1,999-2,199, Minisforum MS-S1 MAX ~$1,800-2,000, Framework 192GB PRO 495 ~$3,500-4,000.
